driver.js 1.10.2 (MIT, Kamran Ahmed): https://github.com/kamranahmedse/driver.js

Copied unchanged from the npm package `driver.js@1.10.2` (`dist/driver.js.iife.js`, `dist/driver.css`, `license`),
4 Nov 2026, for the guided tour (services/tour.py). Kept here rather than loaded from a CDN, so the tour doesn't
depend on one being up. To update it, run `npm pack driver.js@<version>` and copy the same three files.
